title: Reality Fracture
description: Desires manifest so violently that the laws of physics break.

fragments.prompt: Because desires are amplified to critical mass, reality constantly fractures. The laws of physics break down: gravity reverses locally when someone exhibits intense greed; colors can be tasted like raw emotion; intense lust makes the marble columns bleed sweet wine; anger causes time to stutter and loop for a few seconds. The scene must remain playable, but these surreal, psychedelic interruptions happen frequently during dialogue and movement.
fragments.heavenRule: Inject at least one reality-breaking sensory detail into every response based on the current emotional context.
fragments.contentBoundary: The reality breaks must hinder or disorient, but not instantly kill or trap the player permanently.

generationHints.preferredUse: Use to make the environment feel unstable and alien.
generationHints.avoidUse: Do not let the chaos make the Iron Door disappear or invalidate the player's choices.

qualityNotes: High chaos value creates a memorable, terrifying atmosphere.
Forces the player to adapt to non-Euclidean or nonsensical logic.
